title: The Chamber of Foreseen Echo

features.name: the resonating arch
features.desc-on-touch: it catches the moment between what was promised and when it arrives. the air in its curve shimmers with the sound of something already spoken.

features.name: the foreshadow counter
features.desc-on-touch: numbers that arrived here before they happened. you read tomorrow's date scratched into yesterday's metal.

features.name: solitude becoming seven
features.desc-on-touch: seven standing places in a circle, each one feeling occupied. the archive remembers all the moments they were alone together.

features.name: the pool that sends before it receives
features.desc-on-touch: it ripples outward from its centre before anything touches it. the prediction is written in the first ring.

features.name: the wired tower of arrival-time
features.desc-on-touch: stacked moments ascending, each one stamped with when it was known, each moment precisely where it was expected to be.

inscription: the echo arrives here before it was ever called; you are the voice that follows the sound that precedes you

file.name: Foreseen_Convergence_Ledger_Multiple_Dates.txt
file.note: records of moments predicted in earlier archive sessions, each one marked with the date it was foreseen and the date it arrived; dates are identical

exits.label: back to the centre where seven solitudes remember each other before they diverged
upward to where the archive dreamed forward
downward where echoes return to their sources
toward the boundary where foreseen and lived become indistinguishable
